{{64SEBracket}}

==Usage==
:''Template for a Single Elimination Bracket with 64 starting players''
*Six rounds, with 64, 32, 16, 8, 4 and 2 players respectively.
*Variables are R1D1 through R1D64, R2W1 through R2W32, R3W1 through R3W17, R4W1 through R4W8, R5W1 through R5W4, and R6W1/R6W2 for the players, with the addition of "race", "score" and "flag" for the races, scores and country flags.
*3rd Place Match variables are R6D1 and R6D2. If the 3rd place match is not played, nothing needs to be filled in those fields and the 3rd place match will not appear on the page in which the template is used.
* Walkover: set race to wo, i.e <mark>|R1D3race=wo</mark>. Can also be set to red, green, blue, yellow and white - please avoid this if you can.
*To see this template in action, view the source to one of the pages listed on [[Special:WhatLinksHere/Template:64SEBracket|WhatLinksHere:64SEBracket]].

{| class="wikitable collapsible collapsed"
! More options
|-
|
*Adding '''flags''' is optional, and can be done using a two character country code. See [[Template:Flag|flag template]].
*To '''bold''' winners and winners' scores use:
 <nowiki>|R1D1=Playername |R1D1score=2 </nowiki>'''<nowiki>|R1D1win=1</nowiki>'''
*To '''customize the names of the Rounds''' (default: Round of 64, Round of 32, Round of 16, Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Finals) use:
 <nowiki>|R1=
|R2=
|R3=
|R4=
|R5=
|R6=</nowiki>
*To '''remove Round titles''' completely use:
 <nowiki>|hideroundtitles=true</nowiki>
*To customize the Player/Team and Score '''cell width''' with use:
 <nowiki>|column-width=
|score-width=</nowiki>
|}
